What are Workato Decision models?
While looking at Workato's Product Scoop, I came across something called Decision models.
It claims to simplify complex conditional branching? So, I decided to try it out a bit.
What are Decision models?

They are a Workato feature that centralizes and makes complex conditional business logic reusable. Once you create the logic, you can reuse it across multiple recipes and projects, improving consistency and reducing maintenance.
Defines rules that evaluate data using Condition fields and output Outcome fields based on business logic.
Defines the input schema for the Decision model. Data provided from the calling recipe becomes available to each node within the model.

[Tried it] Automating newsletter operations with Workato × Gemini × Marketo
Have you been hearing the term "iPaaS" more often lately?

iPaaS (Integration Platform as a Service) is a platform for automating business processes by connecting different cloud services and applications via APIs. A key feature of iPaaS is the ability to build workflows without writing code, such as a sequence where "when data is entered into Google Forms, automatically notify Slack and register the data in another system."

And now that AI-powered business automation is gaining attention in the marketing world, there is significant potential in combining iPaaS with AI. Many marketers use ChatGPT or Gemini manually to create website content, but have you ever thought, "Wouldn't it be easier if I could incorporate that into a workflow and automate the posting process as well?"
This time, I actually tested how much newsletter operation can be automated using
, one of the leading iPaaS services. Workato is an enterprise-grade iPaaS that supports connections with over 1,000 applications and allows you to build workflows called "recipes" without code.
